safety.clearance.subtitle: Safety cases per cell class, evaluation suites and incidents
safety.clearance.title: Safety
safety.prose.1: This pushes the machine into Annex I part A of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, i.e. mandatory assessment by a notified body, for which no established method of demonstrating conformity exists. Safety must be enforced by a separate deterministic layer.
safety.prose.2: clearance applies to a cell class, not a single cell — otherwise every new cell would require a fresh safety case
safety.prose.3: force and pressure limits (ISO/TS 15066) make sense where contact with a human is possible — requiring them behind a fence would be a ritual
safety.ui.twoAxisClassification: two-axis classification: whether anyone was harmed and whether the safety layer engaged
safety.ui.withdrawCaseForClass: they withdraw the safety case for the cell class
